title: South Coast Sailing Adventures
specs: Award-winning ASA certified sailing school with USCG licensed captains
Largest sailboat fleet in Houston area
No prerequisites for Introduction to Sailing Program
No prerequisites for ASA 118 but 101 & 103 recommended

options.name: Marine Diesel Engine Maintenance
options.detail: 7-hour class on diesel engine systems, maintenance, and basic repairs for boat owners and charterers.

options.name: Introduction to Sailing Program
options.detail: 3-hour hands-on lesson covering basic sailing terminology, rigging, and maneuvers aboard training vessels; not ASA certified.

options.name: ASA 117 Basic Celestial Endorsement Certification (In Person)
options.detail: Learn to use sextant and Nautical Almanac to determine position at sea.

options.name: ASA 119 Marine Weather Endorsement
options.detail: Course on planning and navigation considering weather for local and offshore voyages.

options.name: ASA 101 Basic Keelboat Certification
options.detail: 2-day course learning to sail on a Colgate 26 in light to moderate conditions; includes certification fee, textbook, and logbook.

options.name: Coastal Navigation (ASA 105) Online Class
options.detail: Self-paced online class requiring 40 to 60 hours to complete.

options.name: ASA 103 Basic Coastal Cruising Certification
options.detail: Able to cruise safely as skipper and crew on 25-35 ft auxiliary powered sailboat in moderate conditions.

options.name: ASA 118 Docking Endorsement Certification
options.detail: Course developing docking skills and securing sailboats in various conditions.

options.name: ASA 104 Bareboat Chartering Certification
options.detail: 3 days, 2-night live aboard course for advanced cruising on 30-50 ft boats by day in coastal waters.

options.name: ASA 103 & 104 Combination Course Certification
options.detail: Combined 3 nights, 3-day live aboard adventure of courses 103 and 104.

options.name: ASA 106 Advanced Coastal Cruising Certification
options.detail: Advanced skipper and crew skills for 30-50 ft boats in any weather, day and night.

options.name: ASA 105 Coastal Navigation Certification
options.detail: 2 classroom days teaching navigational theory for coastal or inland waters; no on-water skills required.

options.name: ASA 117 Basic Celestial Endorsement Certification (Online)
options.detail: Self-paced online class requiring 15 to 30 hours to complete.

blurb: South Coast Sailing Adventures offers sailing lessons, captained cruises, bareboat charters, and overnight accommodations aboard sailboats at Seabrook Marina. Their school is an American Sailing Association Certified Training Facility with ASA certified instructors and USCG licensed captains. They provide internationally recognized certification programs and a large fleet of sailboats for various sailing experiences.
